sources.label: MIT Sloan MFin Tuition & Financial Aid

awards.name: MIT Sloan Master of Finance Fellowship
awards.description: Limited fellowships for admitted MFin candidates of all citizenships and academic backgrounds. Established through a gift to MIT Sloan; no separate application. Recipients typically notified at admission.
awards.eligibility: Admitted MIT Sloan MFin students. Applies to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and international students. Automatic consideration based on academic records, personal achievements, professional promise.
awards.note: Distinct from MIT Sloan MBA fellowships (SCH-025). Partner nationality funds listed on same page (Aker/Norway, FGB/Spain, Instituto Ling/Brazil, Kennedy Trust/UK, Habib/Lebanon, Kuo Sharper) are NOT separate SCH cards here — nationality-specific; see brief.

sources.label: Master's Degree Funding (MFin not fully funded)

awards.name: Princeton Bendheim Center MFin Partial Tuition Fellowships (Andlinger / Bendheim / Biglari)
awards.state: Select students; Statement of Financial Resources required at application
awards.description: Partial fellowships in support of tuition offered to select MFin students each year. BCF Annual Report 2026 notes four fellows in 2025–26 across three endowed fellowships: Andlinger ’52 Graduate Fellowship in Finance, Bendheim Graduate Fellowship in Finance, Biglari Graduate Fellowships in Finance. Graduate School: Finance (Master's) applicants must complete Statement of Financial Resources; assistance awarded on academic merit, promise, and need. MFin is NOT on the Graduate School list of fully funded master's programs — expect primarily self-pay unless awarded.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Princeton MFin students. International applicants use the same application; funding is not citizenship-limited in Graduate School general language. Amounts and selection criteria beyond 'select students' / merit+need not published as fixed packages.
awards.amount: Partial tuition (amounts not published; not full funding)
awards.deadline: With application (Statement of Financial Resources); Dec 15, 2026 app deadline for Fall 2027
awards.note: Central Graduate School master's funding page does not list Finance M.Fin. as a fully funded program.

sources.label: Olin MSF Cost, Aid and Scholarships

awards.name: WashU Olin MS in Finance Merit Scholarships
awards.description: Every applicant admitted to Olin MSF is automatically considered for merit-based scholarship; no separate application. Same criteria as admission but more competitive. Award notified in writing at admission. Distinct from Olin Full-Time MBA merit/signature scholarships (SCH-052).
awards.eligibility: Admitted Olin MSF students. Page does not restrict by citizenship. U.S. Armed Forces admits also considered for Olin Veterans Association Fellowships / Yellow Ribbon (US military — not intl).
awards.note: overlapsWithExisting SCH-052 is MBA-only — do not merge.

sources.label: International applicants — GA not for I-20

awards.name: Georgia State Robinson MS Finance Graduate Assistantships
awards.state: Auto-considered at admission; also post-admit Handshake applications
awards.description: Graduate research/administrative assistantships offset MS Finance costs. Applicants with completed applications are automatically considered for GA awards at admission; others may apply via Handshake after deposit. For Finance (12-month) sample: GA tuition waiver $14,865.50 + stipend estimate $5,000; out-of-country remaining cost with stipend ≈ $29,513.50 (published sample; subject to change). F-1 students are eligible. Cannot be counted toward I-20 minimum funding.
awards.eligibility: Admitted RCB graduate students; min 3.0 GPA; register 9 credits fall/spring (6 summer); U.S. work authorization — F-1 eligible (need SSN after hire). Priority GA consideration: apply by Round 2 (Jan 25, 2027) for Fall 2027. Intl needing visa must apply by Round 3 (Mar 15, 2027).
awards.amount: Sample Finance 12-mo: waiver $14,865.50 + stipend ~$5,000 (published breakdown; varies by appointment)
awards.deadline: Priority with Round 2 app (2027-01-25); positions also post near term start
awards.note: Evening Buckhead MSF — GA requires weekday daytime campus availability (8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.), which may conflict with work schedules.

sources.label: USC Marshall MSF Tuition + Fees / Scholarships

awards.name: USC Marshall MS Finance Scholarships
awards.description: Limited MSF scholarships for admitted students based on holistic assessment. No separate application. U.S. citizens and international students eligible. Apply Round 1 or 2 for priority scholarship consideration. Program itself does not offer RA/TA (students may seek on-campus after start).
awards.eligibility: Admitted USC Marshall MSF students; international students explicitly eligible.
awards.note: Distinct from USC Marshall Full-Time MBA merit (SCH-056).

awards.name: Brandeis School of Business and Economics MSF Merit Scholarships
awards.description: 100% of admitted students automatically considered for partial and full-tuition merit scholarships (leadership, academic achievement, personal background, graduate education focus). FAQ: scholarships range from $5,000 to full tuition; notified in admission letter. Domestic and international students included. Merit awards apply to tuition only.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Brandeis SBE MSF (and other SBE master's) students from the U.S. and around the world; automatic consideration.
awards.amount: $5,000 to full tuition (FAQ); exact award in admission letter
awards.note: A Fall 2026 'guaranteed $10,000 scholarship for all admitted SBE graduate students' appeared in search snippets of older admissions copy; live Fall 2027 pages fetched 2026-10-26 confirm auto merit $5k–full tuition but do NOT clearly restate a universal $10k guarantee — do not treat $10k as verified for Fall 2027.

awards.name: Utah Eccles MSF Merit Scholarship
awards.description: Admissions scholarship acknowledging academic, personal, and professional accomplishments. Potential award $0–$3,000. Separate 300–500 word essay to MSF@Utah.edu. Only one admissions scholarship per student. Funding limited; first-come first-serve. Requirements must be met before Nov 1 (spring) or June 1 (fall).
awards.eligibility: Newly admitted MSF students who have not started the program. No citizenship restriction stated. UU employees on reduced tuition benefit ineligible. Program does not offer GA/fellowships.
awards.deadline: Before Nov 1 (spring start) or June 1 (fall start); first-come first-serve

awards.name: Utah Eccles MSF Community Impact Scholarship
awards.description: For candidates with exceptional leadership in public sector or non-profits / community impact. Potential award $0–$3,000. 300–500 word essay to MSF@Utah.edu. One admissions scholarship only per student.
awards.eligibility: Newly admitted MSF students; community/public-sector leadership. No citizenship restriction stated.
awards.deadline: Before Nov 1 (spring) or June 1 (fall); first-come first-serve

awards.name: UT Austin McCombs MS Program Scholarships (Admissions Recruiting Awards)
awards.description: Limited scholarships for Texas McCombs MS Program students. All MS applicants automatically considered; no separate application. Considered separately within each degree program (MSF has its own pool).
awards.eligibility: Admitted McCombs MS students including MSF. Page does not restrict by citizenship for these admissions scholarships.

sources.label: McCombs MSF Tuition & Financial Aid — Flywheel

awards.name: UT Austin McCombs MSF Flywheel Scholarship
awards.description: Candidates admitted to MSF may be eligible to apply for the Flywheel Scholarship, estimated at $20,000 over the course of the program. Awarded to applicants pivoting careers and first-generation college students. Applications invitation-only; sent after admission.
awards.eligibility: Admitted MSF students invited to apply; career-pivot and/or first-generation. Citizenship not specified on page → intlEligible unclear for invitation criteria, but not explicitly U.S.-only.
awards.deadline: Invitation after admission (no public fixed deadline)

awards.name: Utah Eccles MSF Alumni Scholarship (University of Utah undergrad alumni)
awards.state: Automatic for eligible UU alumni admits
awards.description: Automatically awarded to newly admitted students who completed an undergraduate degree within the past five years at the University of Utah. Potential $0–$500. Not an international recruitment award.
awards.eligibility: UU bachelor's within past 5 years; newly admitted MSF. Rarely relevant for HK/TW/PRC applicants.
